name: Infoblox — NXDOMAIN Storm (DGA Indicator)
xql_query:
datamodel dataset = infoblox_infoblox_raw
| filter xdm.event.type = "DNS Response" and xdm.event.outcome_reason = "NXDOMAIN"
| filter xdm.source.ipv4 != null
| alter domain = arrayindex(regextract(xdm.event.description, "query: (\S+) IN"), 0)
| bin _time span = 10m
| comp count() as nxd,
       count_distinct(xdm.event.description) as distinct_nxd_queries,
       values(domain) as failed_domains
       by xdm.source.ipv4, _time
| filter nxd >= 80 and distinct_nxd_queries >= 30
| fields xdm.source.ipv4, failed_domains
description: High volume of NXDOMAIN responses for one client — DGA / typosquat probing.

TA0011 - Command and Control: T1568.002 - Dynamic Resolution: Domain Generation Algorithms
